name: 80212 · Denver, CO
findings: ZIP 80212 (Denver) has 89 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 33 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80212 (Denver) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 80212 (Denver) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 67% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 49 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.
